name: show-me
description: View Mermaid diagrams from Claude’s answers as rendered images in a side pane. It requires the Mermaid command-line renderer and a terminal with Kitty graphics support.
sourceDescription: Draws the mermaid diagrams of each answer as images in a pane (/show-me); needs mmdc and a kitty-graphics terminal such as Ghostty
author: Mehmet Aras
